hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A valid subarray must begin and end with equal values x such that all intermediate elements are less than or equal to x.

hints.title: Stack Invariant
hints.text: Maintain elements in strictly non-increasing order. Any element strictly less than incoming x cannot bridge past x and must be discarded.

hints.title: Frequency Matching
hints.text: When top element equals x, increment its recorded frequency and add that frequency to the total count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element is pushed and popped at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) subarrays with range maximum checks takes O(n^3) or O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a monotonic stack storing (value, frequency) pairs to group valid boundary matches in linear time.
